names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 11 octombrie, «Sfântul Ierarh Teofan Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Niceei».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Οκτωβρίου, «Όσιος Θεοφάνης ο Γραπτός, ο Ομολογητής επίσκοπος Νίκαιας», with the rank words left off; the epithet «ο Γραπτός», the branded, is the page's own.

floruit.note: The one year the page fixes him by, and it is not his own death: «In 838, it says, he buried his brother Theodore with great grief when he died in exile», after which Theophanes was himself exiled to Thessalonica. No year of his repose is printed.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 11 octombrie — «Sfântul Ierarh Teofan Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Niceei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Οκτωβρίου — «Όσιος Θεοφάνης ο Γραπτός, ο Ομολογητής επίσκοπος Νίκαιας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: the brother of Theodore the Branded, learned in the Scriptures and in the ancient Greek writers, who buried his brother in 838 and was afterwards exiled to Thessalonica, and whom the patriarch Methodius made metropolitan of Nicaea after the death of the iconoclast emperor Theophilus. The page gives 838 for the burial of his brother and no year for his own death, so no `dates` object is proposed. It records a portion of his relic at the monastery of Prousos in Eurytania. It prints a proper apolytikion naming him and a kontakion naming him, both taken here, and an «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον», the common of a teacher of Orthodoxy with his name in it, which is not drafted. Its Theodore the Branded, referred to 27 Δεκεμβρίου, has no folder in the corpus, so he is named in the added paragraph and not linked. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Îndreptătorule al Ortodoxiei, învățătorule al dreptei cinstiri de Dumnezeu şi al curăției şi luminătorule al lumii, podoaba călugărilor cea de Dumnezeu insuflată Sfinte Părinte Teofan, înțelepte, cu învățăturile tale pe toți i-ai luminat. Alăută duhovnicească, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Teofan Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Niceei

english.text: O guide of Orthodoxy, teacher of true reverence for God and of purity, luminary of the world, God-inspired adornment of monks: O wise father Theophanes, by thy teachings thou hast enlightened all. O spiritual harp, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Μυηθεῖς τῶν Ἀγγέλων Πάτερ τὸ σύντονον, θεοφανείας ἀρρήτου ἐδείχθης σάλπιγξ χρυσή, περιούσιον λαὸν τρέφων τοὶς λόγοις σου, τῶν γὰρ πανσόφων σου ᾠδῶν, ἡ πανεύσημος μολπή, εὐφραίνει τὴν Ἐκκλησίαν, δι' ἣν λαμπρῶς ἠγωνίσω, θεομακάριστε Θεόφανες.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ήχος πλ α', Τον συνάναρχον λόγον — the first hymn on the page of «Όσιος Θεοφάνης ο Γραπτός, ο Ομολογητής επίσκοπος Νίκαιας», and it names him. The «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον» printed under it is the common of a teacher of Orthodoxy and is not drafted.

english.text: Initiated, father, into the intensity of the angels, you were shown to be a golden trumpet of the unutterable manifestation of God, feeding a peculiar people with your words; for the far-famed singing of your all-wise odes gladdens the Church, for which you contended brilliantly, Theophanes blessed of God.

hymns.text: Ἀνεφάνης Ὅσιε, τῇ Ἐκκλησίᾳ ὥσπερ ἄλλος ἥλιος, ταύτην φωτίζων ἀστραπαῖς, τῶν σῶν δογμάτων Θεόφανες, ὣς θυηπόλος, Χριστοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ', Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον — on the page of «Όσιος Θεοφάνης ο Γραπτός, ο Ομολογητής επίσκοπος Νίκαιας», and it names him.

english.text: You appeared to the Church, venerable one, like another sun, lighting her with the lightnings of your doctrines, Theophanes, as a priest of Christ our God.
